newsitem.title: USA: Universal Hospital sets merger vote date.
newsitem.headline: Universal Hospital sets merger vote date.

text.p: Universal Hospital Services Inc said Friday it set April 4 as the date for a meeting at which its shareholders will be asked to approve a merger with MEDIQ Inc.
It said only Universal's shareholders of record on February 26 will be entitled to vote at the special meeting.

On February 11, the two companies said they entered into a definitive agreement for MEDIQ to acquire Universal for $17.50 per share. Including the assumption of debt, the total purchase price is about $138 million.
Universal provides movable medical equipment to hospitals and alternate care providers. MEDIQ operates a critical care and life support medical equipment rental business.
